correctness.rationale: For C³ uniformly positive curvature, normal coordinates at K-L have exact Jacobian m(θ)-s. Tangency expansion gives G=4/3 sqrt(2/q(θ)) s^(3/2)+O(s²), uniformly in the normal angle; inversion yields depth c q^(1/3) ε^(2/3)+O(ε), c³=9/32. Integrating proves the direction-marked tail and conditional independent Beta(2/3,1) overlap fraction. The limit plus M identifies m and q, thus the unordered curvature radii from a quadratic. Equality of m q^(1/3) with affine-arclength weight m^(2/3) means mq constant; continuity forces ρ1/ρ2 constant, and support functions differing by cosine/sine characterize translated reflected homothety. Independent circle lens quadrature checks corroborate, not prove, the general limit.
